page.overview:
Who is Bioluminescent Carnotaurus?

The bioluminescent Carnotaurus is a Carnotaurus variant featured in the Minecraft Jurassic World DLC. It is a hybrid between Carnotaurus and cuttlefish.

The bioluminescent Carnotaurus's body appears identical to the normal InGen clones. However, it has an ashy grey body with a dark grey back and blue bioluminescent spots and stripes running down its back and along its sides. It also has a blue tongue and blue claws, unlike the normal InGen clones.

The bioluminescent Carnotaurus appears as an optional skin variant for the Carnotaurus. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Carnotaurus DNA; 2 samples of any Large DNA; and 1 sample of Cuttlefish DNA.
